WELCOME TO OUR BEAUTIFUL TOWN
-----------------------------

### BREWSTER, WA

Brewster was officially incorporated on April 29, 1910. In 1811, David Stewart of Astor's Pacific Fur Company established Fort Okanogan, the first American post in Washington, just north of the present site of Brewster. In 1859, the area experienced a gold rush and by 1880, steamboats became a common sight on the Columbia River as far North as Brewster.

Old HWY 97 ProjectOld HWY 97 Project
------------------------------------

slide 1 of 1

### WHAT'S HAPPENING AROUND BREWSTER?

On US 97 at milepost 260 (intersection Old Highway 97 in Brewster), Monday through Friday from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m., plan for flagger-controlled traffic and pilot car with some delays where a contractor for the City of Brewster is improving Old Highway 97 in Brewster. April 29 to May 9 access onto Old Highway 97 is closed at intersection with US 97 for concrete work. Project is scheduled to be complete the end of May. Click below to see updates.
